_what: The semantic ORACLE's own arithmetic. A quiet wrong answer here would make the gate agree with a wrong rewrite, so the helper is mutated too -- it is test code, but it is test code the verdict rests on.

mutants.name: O1 shift-out of a negative operand returns zero
O2 arithmetic fill dropped entirely
O3 results not truncated to the node width
mutants.old: uint64_t trunc_to(uint64_t v, int bits) { return v & wmask(bits); }
mutants.new: uint64_t trunc_to(uint64_t v, int bits) { (void)bits; return v; }
